950-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-8095.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-8095.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

122-328-2732-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

141-7166-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-7166-8095.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2738-4871-5256-7316.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
413-6972-7804.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1263-2292-4556-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4068-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4068-4659-7344.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2539-3094-4068-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3110-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3165-3532-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

579-2366-4885-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-4885-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1761-4153.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Delaying Shield triggers.
Holding priority, if Delaying Shield has any delay counters on it, activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving the delay counters from Delaying Shield onto Resourceful Defense.
Resolve the Delaying Shield trigger, doing nothing.
While Delaying Shield is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is replaced by putting that many counters on Delaying Shield instead.
Repeat each turn as necessary.

821-2173-5220-6273.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

803-2438-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-2438-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

116-3455-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Many Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vizier of Many Faces do not have summoning sickness.
116-3455-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Many Faces.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Vizier of Many Faces.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

864-957-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Eternal Witness.
864-957-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the token Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

311-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coral Trickster, adding {U}.
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

1620-2404-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1620-2404-4067.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If you control at least six creatures, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.

632-1978-2034-3621.notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-1978-2034-3621.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.

962-2143-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Yurlok.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
962-2143-2178.description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawns die, Yurlok triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next phase, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to the mana in their mana pool.

395-3263-4659-4840-4853.notablePrerequisites: Hanna does not have summoning sickness.
395-3263-4659-4840-4853.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {2}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Hanna or any other artifact.
Repeat from step 3 for each of the four Myr creature tokens.
Activate Hanna by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-3525-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Chromatic Orrery.
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3525-4694.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have an infinite amount of {C}, you may use it to activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability.

2366-4222-4495.notablePrerequisites:
New Horzions and Freed from the Real attached to Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor does not have summoning sickness.
2366-4222-4495.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-3966.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
314-3966.description:
Gain life.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
